instruction: Nicholas has requested me to buy "Amazon Kindle (9th Generation)" on amazon for them as their card is currently blocked. Place the order and forward the confirmation email containing the receipt to them, and make a venmo request to them for the total cost of the order, with a description note, "Order on Amazon".
notes: Nicholas's card is blocked, so the order is paid with the supervisor's own Amazon payment card and shipped to an existing address (no address changes). amazon.clear_cart precedes add_product_to_cart so the placed order contains exactly one unit of the Kindle. Placing the order automatically generates the 'Amazon Order Confirmation' email with the receipt attachment (this explains the gmail.Attachment/file_system changes; no file_system login is needed). The order total is read via amazon.show_order and used as the Venmo request amount with description 'Order on Amazon'. Nicholas's email address is discovered via venmo.search_friends (same email is used for the Venmo request and the Gmail forward), so the Venmo login/search must precede the forward; the planner orders this via (known-email ...). gmail.show_inbox_threads finds the confirmation thread, gmail.show_thread exposes the email id, and forward_email_from_thread forwards that specific email (subject becomes 'Fwd: Amazon Order Confirmation' and response_to_email_id is set automatically). supervisor-complete-task takes the task records (order, product, friend, note) as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; no answer is passed. The 'entity' supertype groups ids discovered at runtime under (known-id ...).
